stem:
At a Massachusetts community pharmacy, the pharmacist is on duty and available. Each proposed assignment below is evaluated with the employee’s current state license and certification. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A certified technician makes a permitted Schedule II perpetual-inventory entry subject to the pharmacy’s controls.
A supervised Massachusetts intern counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
A trained cashier selects an unfilled prescription stock bottle and counts tablets before ringing up the sale.
A pharmacist performs final patient-specific prescription verification after an intern prepares the medication.
An external maintenance worker enters the prescription area alone because the pharmacy has issued a visitor badge.

stem:
A Massachusetts employer is evaluating licensing records before authorizing work or opening a location. No special Board waiver or military exception has been granted. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist waits for Massachusetts license issuance before beginning independent pharmacist duties.
An Idaho-licensed pharmacist uses the Massachusetts reciprocity process and completes the remaining MA requirements.
A pharmacy obtaining Board application approval assumes it can first open several years later without further written permission.
A reciprocity applicant restarts the one-year validity each time a document is uploaded to the Board.
A retail pharmacy maintains its Drug Store license and obtains the additional license required for sterile compounding.

stem:
A resident Massachusetts Drug Store pharmacy is planning operational changes. Any reporting deadlines expressly left unresolved in the notes are outside this question. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail MOR works an average of at least 30 hours weekly at the managed pharmacy.
An incoming owner treats the signed bill of sale as transferring the old pharmacy license into the new owner’s name.
A pharmacy files a relocation application 90 days in advance and moves without awaiting Board approval.
Outgoing and incoming MORs attest to an inventory including II–V and PMP-reportable VI drugs.
A pharmacist serves concurrently as MOR for two retail Drug Store pharmacies with nonoverlapping opening hours.
